title: Finance Executive – Statutory  and  Tax
description:
**Job Summary**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented
 **Finance Executive – Statutory \& Tax** 
 to manage end\-to\-end statutory compliances, SEZ compliance, direct and indirect tax filings, statutory/internal audits, and labour law compliances for ValueMentor group. The role requires close coordination with internal finance and payroll teams as well as external auditors and government authorities to ensure 100% compliance adherence, timely tax filings, and audit\-ready books of accounts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities, Deliverables / Outcomes**
**Direct \& Indirect Tax Compliance:**
* Prepare and file monthly/quarterly GST returns (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B) and perform monthly GSTR\-2B reconciliations with purchase registers.
* Compute monthly TDS/TCS liabilities, ensure timely deposit, and handle quarterly TDS returns (Form 24Q, 26Q).
* Coordinate annual tax filings, advance tax computations, and tax audit schedules.
* Diligently complete all SEZ Compliances \& Customs Documentation for our SEZ unit.


**Statutory Labor Compliances**
* Manage monthly processing and payment calculations for Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESIC), Professional Tax (PT), and Labor Welfare Fund (LWF).
* Ensure timely filing of monthly/annual labour returns and maintain statutory registers.


**Audit Management \& Coordination**
* Act as the key operational point of contact for Statutory, Internal, and Tax Audits.
* Prepare detailed audit schedules, trial balance reconciliations, balance confirmations, and ledger analysis to ensure smooth audit completion without adverse observations.


**Financial Reconciliations \& Controls**
* Perform monthly reconciliations between general ledger entries, tax portals, and bank statements.
* Identify data mismatches at the source level and implement preventive internal controls.


**Regulatory Filings \& Notice Management**
* Track and update the internal Statutory Compliance Calendar to maintain zero missed deadlines.
* Assist in drafting replies to notices, inquiries, or communications from tax or statutory authorities.


**Key Skills**
* Taxation \& Compliance Expertise: Hands\-on working knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax regulations, and statutory labour laws (PF, ESIC, PT, LWF).
* Audit Execution: Proven experience in preparing audit working papers, trial balance reconciliations, and managing auditor deliverables.
* Accounting \& Financial Literacy: Strong grasp of accounting concepts, general ledger maintenance, and financial statement preparation.
* ERP \& Excel Proficiency: Advanced MS Excel skills (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data reconciliation) and hands\-on experience with ERP systems (Tally, Zoho, SAP, or Oracle).


**Key Competencies**
***Intellectual***
* Analysis Skills – High numerical precision; ability to conduct root\-cause analysis on tax and accounting mismatches.


 Judgment / Decision Making – Evaluates tax risks, determines correct applicability of statutory provisions, and exercises care with sensitive financial data.
   

  

***Interpersonal***
 Communications – Oral \& Written – Drafts clear, well\-structured emails, audit explanations, and initial responses to tax/statutory notices. Communicates complex tax and compliance requirements clearly to non\-finance operational teams and HR.
   

  

***Personal***
 Integrity – Uncompromised professional ethics and adherence to statutory laws and corporate governance standards.
   

  

 Organization / Planning – Rigorous timeline management to meet strict monthly and quarterly statutory deadlines.

title: Financial Analyst – Investor Relations
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented Financial Analyst to support the Director – Finance in consolidating and presenting financial and business data for investor reporting, and in building the organisation's readiness for a future Initial Public Offering (IPO). The role involves close coordination across Finance, Accounts, Legal and business teams to compile accurate, timely and audit\-ready data, financial models, MIS reports and disclosures required for existing as well as prospective investors and prospective IPO due diligence. The ideal candidate combines strong financial and analytical skills with meticulous attention to detail, the ability to handle confidential data responsibly, and the discipline to work to tight reporting timelines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities, Deliverables / Outcomes**
**Investor Data Collation \& Reporting:** 
 Collect, consolidate and validate financial and operational data from various departments (Accounts, Sales, HR, Operations) to prepare periodic investor reports, board packs and MIS dashboards for the Director – Finance.
   

  

**IPO Readiness Support:** 
 Assist in preparing and organising financial statements, schedules, disclosures and supporting documentation required for IPO due diligence, in coordination with auditors, legal counsel, merchant bankers and IPO consultants.
   

  

**Data Room Management:** 
 Build, maintain and continuously update a well\-organised financial / legal data room for investor and IPO due diligence purposes, ensuring version control and confidentiality.
   

  

**Financial Analysis \& MIS:** 
 Prepare variance analysis, trend analysis, KPI trackers and financial models / schedules to support investor queries and management decision\-making.
   

  

**Stakeholder Coordination:** 
 Liaise with internal stakeholders (Accounts, CEO Office, Global Leadership team) and external parties (auditors, bankers, consultants) to ensure timely and accurate data flow.
   

  

**Compliance \& Governance:** 
 Ensure accuracy, consistency and confidentiality across all investor and IPO\-related documentation; support adherence to applicable listing / regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Presentation Support:** 
 Assist in preparing investor presentations, fact sheets and Q\&A briefs for management and Board meetings.
   

  

**Process Improvement:** 
 Help standardise templates and processes for recurring investor reporting to improve turnaround time and accuracy.
   

  

**Key Skills**
 Strong working knowledge of financial statements and accounting concepts (IFRS / applicable local GAAP)
   

  

 Working knowledge of the IPO process, due diligence requirements and stock exchange listing norms is an added advantage
   

  

 Advanced MS Excel (financial modelling, data consolidation, pivot tables) and PowerPoint
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with ERP / accounting systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Tally, Zoho) for data extraction and reconciliation
   

  

 Ability to build and maintain structured, version\-controlled data rooms and documentation.
   

  

**Key Competencies**
***Intellectual***
 Analysis Skills – Interprets complex financial data and translates it into clear, decision\-useful information.
   

  

 Judgment / Decision Making – Exercises sound judgment while handling sensitive, time\-critical investor information.
   

  

***Interpersonal***
 Communications – Oral \& Written – Prepares clear reports, MIS and presentations; communicates effectively with cross\-functional and external stakeholders.
   

  

***Personal***
 Integrity – Handles confidential investor and IPO\-related financial data with the highest standards of honesty and discretion.
   

  

 Organization / Planning – Manages multiple data requests and reporting deadlines in a structured, timeline\-driven manner.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:

* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives

* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel

* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline

* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects

 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Medlounges is a private hospital and wellness centre offering a holistic blend of medical and lifestyle services. The facility includes key departments such as Cosmetology, Dermatology, Ayurveda, Family Medicine, and Dentistry, supported by a 24\-hour pharmacy, physiotherapy unit, laboratory, and optical shop. An additional OPD wing with seating for 80–85 people serves the surrounding community and hosts specialist doctors for private practice. Medlounges provides home medical care services, including home visits by physicians and wellness teams, home drug delivery, and lab sample collection. The centre also features a fitness facility, accommodation options, a wellness\-focused restaurant, and an active medical tourism channel operating across multiple countries.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Assistant Manager Finance is a full\-time, on\-site role based at the Medlounges facility in Tiruvalla. This role supports the financial management of hospital and wellness centre operations, including budgeting, forecasting, and monitoring departmental expenditures. The Assistant Manager Finance oversees daily accounting activities such as accounts payable and receivable, general ledger entries, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting. The role involves ensuring compliance with relevant financial regulations, internal controls, and audit requirements, as well as preparing periodic management reports and dashboards. The Assistant Manager Finance collaborates with clinical and administrative teams to analyze financial performance, optimize cost structures, and support strategic initiatives related to medical services, wellness programs, and medical tourism.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong financial management and accounting skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Candidates should possess skills in financial reporting and compliance, including preparation of statements, adherence to regulatory standards, and support for internal and external audits.
* Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting software and spreadsheet tools, along with attention to detail and strong numerical aptitude.
* Candidates should possess organizational and time management skills to handle multiple financial processes and deadlines in a healthcare setting.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with clinical, administrative, and management teams.
* Relevant academic qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA, CMA, ACCA) are an advantage.
* Experience in healthcare, hospital finance, or multi\-department service organizations is preferred, along with familiarity with medical billing and insurance processes.

title: Assistant Manager Finance
description:

title: Accountant
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Ensure financial accuracy, compliance, and strategic insights—manage records, prepare reports, and support decision\-making with precision and integrity. We are seeking a detail‑oriented and analytical Accountant to join our Accounts team in Thrissur. The role involves maintaining financial records, preparing statements, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, and supporting audits. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise with problem‑solving skills to provide clear financial insights and contribute to organizational growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date financial records, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger.
* Prepare financial statements such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow reports.
* Assist in budgeting and forecasting, monitoring performance against projections.
* Analyse financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, regulations, and internal policies.
* Prepare management and stakeholder reports with clarity and accuracy.
* Support internal and external audits, ensuring timely resolution of findings.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field; professional certification (CA, CPA, ACCA) preferred.
* Minimum 1 years of relevant work experience.
* Females only
* Strong knowledge of accounting software (Tally, Zoho) and proficiency in MS Office tools.
* Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail.
* Strong communication skills to present financial information to non‑financial stakeholders.

title: Accountant (CA Inter or Final Mandatory)
description:
Job Role: Accountant (CA Inter or Final)
 



 Job Description: The Accountant
 
 (CA Inter or Final)
 
 plays a crucial role in managing the organization's cash flow and ensuring precise and timely accounting. This position involves various responsibilities related to bank and cash payments, taxation, reconciliation, and audit support. The candidate must ensure that all financial transactions are compliant with the organization's standards.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* **Payments \& Bank Reconciliation:**
* **Ensure payments are made based on the payment priority provided.**
* **Periodically reconcile all bank accounts to ensure accuracy.**
* **Tally Updates:**
* **Record all payment entries in Tally for both cash and bank payments.**
* **Account for all bank receipts in Tally.**
* **Payment List Management:**
* **Update the Purchase Approval Follow\-up Sheet and Payment List after each payment.**
* **Ensure accurate filing of all bank and cash vouchers.**
* **Tax Deduction:**
* **Ensure tax is deducted at the appropriate rates for all payments, including advances.**
* **Salary Management:**
* **Record salary payable entries in Tally.**
* **Vendor Advance Review:**
* **Periodically review vendor advances and ensure timely settlements.**
* **TDS Management:**
* **Prepare the TDS statement for quarterly returns and manage monthly TDS payments.**
* **Audit and Due Diligence:**
* **Assist in the timely completion of statutory audits with no adverse remarks.**
* **Support due diligence or other occasional audits.**



 Requirements:
 


* **Educational Qualification:**
* **Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) is compulsory.**
* **CA Inter or Final** 
**mandatory with 3 years of completed articleship.**
* **Skills:**
* **Proficiency in Tally and a strong grasp of accounting principles.**
* **Attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial transactions.**
* **Good organizational skills and ability to multitask.**
* **Knowledge of tax regulations, including experience in TDS management.**
* **Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with teams.**
* **Experience with Zoho accounting software is an added advantage.**

title: Income Auditor
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an
 **Income Auditor** 
 , you’re not just ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the hotel's financial transactions – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
   

  

* Ensure accurate financial records: Balance and code the previous day’s transactions, preparing daily operating sales and labor summaries
* Verify and audit transactions: Review night audit reports, ensure sales journal accuracy, and analyze all adjustments
* Reconcile banquet revenue: Audit banquet tickets and match them with banquet orders to ensure proper billing
* Monitor financial adjustments: Track and route rebates, miscellaneous charges, promotional tickets, and paid outs
* Maintain recordkeeping: File and archive financial documents in compliance with tax authority requirements
* Collaborate for success: Assist team members and other departments as needed


**Qualifications**
**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
 **Hospitality** 
 . Acting with
 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership** 
 . A belief that
 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now** 
 , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

 At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
